Background.title: Background - SSSUTMS
Background.content_html:
Sri Satya Sai Campus, Sehore came into existence in 1999 with the establishment of Sri Satya Sai Institute of Science & Technology (SSSIST). Initially, SSSIST offered three branches in engineering education with a total intake of 180 students.

By 2012, driven by the vision of its promoters, the Sehore Campus had expanded to twelve colleges, offering twenty undergraduate courses, twenty postgraduate courses, one postgraduate diploma, and one diploma course, with a total intake of 3054 students. The Sri Satya Sai Group of Institutions attracted students from across states due to its commitment to quality education at affordable costs, without hidden fees.

Over fourteen years, the institutions under this group became the only providers of technical education in Sehore and six nearby districts, serving students from more than six thousand villages and 34 tehsils. With 80.6% of the population living at low standards of living and agriculture as the primary occupation, the group played a vital role in uplifting education. The region’s growth rate was recently recorded at 21.5%.

The literacy rate of Sehore district rose to 71.11% in 2011, compared to 63.07% in 2001. Male literacy increased from 77.28% (2001) to 82.37% (2011), while female literacy rose from 47.36% to 58.86% in the same period.

With the establishment of Sri Satya Sai University of Technology & Medical Sciences, the overall educational scenario is expected to improve even further.

Institutes.title: Institutes - SSSUTMS
Institutes.content_html:
The university comprises premier constituent colleges and multidisciplinary faculties offering UG, PG, and Ph.D. programs across engineering, medical, ayurveda, homeopathy, pharmacy, management, law, and education.

  • Sri Satya Sai Institute of Science & Technology
  • School of Pharmacy
  • School of Ayurveda & Siddha Medicine
  • Homoeopathy Medical College & Hospital
  • College of Nursing
  • School of Management & Computer Applications
  • School of Law
  • Faculty of Education

PromotingSociety.title: Promoting Society - SSSUTMS
PromotingSociety.content_html: Sri Satya Sai University of Technology and Medical Sciences is sponsored and promoted by Ayushmati Education and Social Society, Bhopal. The society was founded with the prime objective of spreading quality professional, technical, healthcare, and higher education across Central India, particularly empowering youth from rural and semi-urban backgrounds.

VisionAndMission.title: Vision & Mission - SSSUTMS
VisionAndMission.vision: To emerge as World’s one of the finest Universities in the field of Higher, Technical and Medical Education to develop Professionals who are Technically competent, ethically sensitive and environment friendly, for the betterment of society.
VisionAndMission.mission: Accomplish stimulating learning environment for students through quality teaching, research and outreach activity by providing state of the art facilities, industry exposure and guidance of dedicated faculty.

CoreValues.title: Core Values - SSSUTMS
CoreValues.content_html:
Our core values define the culture, decisions, and ethical standards across our campus:

  1. Academic Integrity & Excellence: Commitment to highest teaching standards, research rigor, and ethical scholarship.
  2. Inclusivity & Diversity: Welcoming talent irrespective of social, economic, or geographical background.
  3. Social Responsibility: Dedication to nation-building, rural upliftment, and sustainable community service.
  4. Innovation & Lifelong Learning: Fostering creative inquiry, practical problem-solving, and adaptability.

BestPractices.title: Best Practices - SSSUTMS
BestPractices.content_html: SSSUTMS institutional best practices encompass continuous community healthcare outreach through teaching hospitals, green sustainable campus operations (solar harvesting, rainwater retention), student-centric outcome-based curriculum, and extensive scholarship support for rural learners.

Chancellor.title: Chancellor - SSSUTMS
Chancellor.name: Mr. Siddharth Kapoor
Chancellor.quote: Under his visionary guidance, Sri Satya Sai University continues to fulfill the dreams and aspirations of the young generation.
Chancellor.bio: Young & Dynamic Chancellor of Sri Satya Sai University of Technology & Medical Sciences, Honourable Mr. Siddharth Kapoor holds a Degree in Family Management Business Administration (FMBA) from SP Jain, Mumbai. He also completed his Masters of Business Administration (Finance) from Temple University, Fox School of Business, Philadelphia.

ViceChancellor.title: Vice Chancellor - SSSUTMS
ViceChancellor.name: Dr. Mukesh Tiwari
ViceChancellor.quote: We continuously aspire to be a breeding ground for positive ideas and emerge as a symbol of openness of thoughts and cultural pluralism.
ViceChancellor.bio: Since its founding in 2013 by merging of several multi-disciplinary institutions, Sri Satya Sai University of Technology and Medical Sciences is acclaimed for its outstanding contribution to teaching, research and service in Nation building.

Registrar.title: Registrar - SSSUTMS

Registrar.quote: Committed to ensuring transparency, efficiency, and student-centric services across all administrative processes.
Registrar.bio: The Registrar is the chief administrative custodian of the university, overseeing admissions, human resources, statutory compliances with UGC, AICTE, PCI, NCISM, NCH, and state regulatory authorities.

Finance_Officer.title: Finance Officer - SSSUTMS
Finance_Officer.name: Mr. Vimal Nath
Finance_Officer.quote: Driving financial performance, optimizing operational efficiencies, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.
Finance_Officer.bio: The Finance Officer manages institutional financial planning, budget allocations, government scholarship distributions, statutory audits, and financial governance.

DeputyRegistrar.title: Deputy Registrar - SSSUTMS
DeputyRegistrar.name: Dr. Kanchan Shrivastava
DeputyRegistrar.quote: Our objective is to improve standards to achieve excellence in higher education and provide high worth education filled with human values.
DeputyRegistrar.bio: Assists the Registrar in day-to-day administrative execution, faculty coordination, student grievances, and university operational logistics.

Exam_Controller.title: Controller of Examinations - SSSUTMS
Exam_Controller.name: (Prof) Dr. Sanjay Rathore
Exam_Controller.designation: M.Sc, M.Phil (Physics), Ph.D | Controller of Examination
Exam_Controller.quote: Ensuring administrative integrity, academic rigour, and fair evaluation standards across all university examinations.
Exam_Controller.bio: Responsible for conducting semester exams, entrance exams (CEET), confidential evaluation, timely declaration of results, grade card issuance, and degree verification.

Chief_Vigilance_Officer.title: Chief Vigilance Officer - SSSUTMS

Chief_Vigilance_Officer.quote: Upholding institutional integrity, administrative vigilance, and high ethical standards across all university affairs.
Chief_Vigilance_Officer.bio: Supervises university vigilance, security, proctorial squad, anti-ragging helpline enforcement, and ensures an atmosphere of discipline and ethical conduct.

GoverningBody.title: Governing Body - SSSUTMS
GoverningBody.content_html: The Governing Body is the apex statutory authority of Sri Satya Sai University of Technology and Medical Sciences, established pursuant to Section 22 of the Madhya Pradesh Niji Vishwavidyalaya Adhiniyam.

BoardOfManagement.title: Board of Management - SSSUTMS
BoardOfManagement.content_html: The Board of Management is responsible for the overall administrative and financial management of the University, appointment of key faculty, and operational governance.

Board_Of_Studies.title: Board of Studies - SSSUTMS
Board_Of_Studies.content_html: Board of Studies across faculties regularly updates outcome-based curricula, examination schemes, modern syllabus credits, and course electives aligned with NEP 2020.

AcademicCouncil.title: Academic Council - SSSUTMS
AcademicCouncil.content_html: The Academic Council is the principal academic body of the University, coordinating curriculum standards, instructional methodologies, and academic regulations.

FinanceCommittee.title: Finance Committee - SSSUTMS
FinanceCommittee.content_html: The Finance Committee advises the Board of Management on financial matters, scrutinizes annual budgets, and oversees fund distributions and institutional investments.

StandingCommittee.title: Standing Committee - SSSUTMS
StandingCommittee.content_html: The Standing Committee handles urgent administrative and academic matters referred by the Governing Body and Academic Council between scheduled meetings.

STATUTES.content_html: Official University Statutes framed under the Madhya Pradesh Niji Vishwavidyalaya (Sthapana Evam Sanchalan) Adhiniyam, defining constitutional governance, powers, and procedures.

HeadOfTheDepartment.content_html: Complete directory of Heads of Departments across all academic programs, engineering specializations, and healthcare clinical departments.

Approvals.title: Approvals - SSSUTMS
Approvals.content_html: State Government Gazette Notification Act no. 06 No.80 dated 12th February 2014, and approvals from UGC (Section 2f), AICTE, PCI, NCISM, NCH, INC, and BCI.

Ordinances.title: Ordinances - SSSUTMS
Ordinances.content_html: Comprehensive University Ordinances governing undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and Ph.D. degree awards, admissions, and examinations.

Transportation.title: Transportation - SSSUTMS
Transportation.content_html: The University operates an extensive fleet of buses connecting Bhopal, Sehore, Ashta, and neighboring districts. Well-connected routes ensure safe, comfortable, and timely transit for day-scholar students and faculty members.

Hostel.title: Hostel Facilities - SSSUTMS
Hostel.content_html: Separate, secure, and modern hostels for boys and girls with round-the-clock security, Wi-Fi connectivity, RO drinking water, hygienic dining mess serving nutritious meals, sports recreation rooms, and resident wardens.

Library.title: Central Library - SSSUTMS
Library.content_html: State-of-the-art Central Library housing over 75,000 volumes, international and national journals, digital subscriptions (DELNET, IEEE), e-book repositories, and air-conditioned reading halls accommodating 500+ scholars.

MedicalFacility.title: Medical Facility - SSSUTMS
MedicalFacility.content_html: On-campus multi-specialty Ayurvedic and Homeopathic teaching hospitals providing 24/7 outpatient and inpatient healthcare, emergency ambulance service, free consultation, and round-the-clock resident medical officers.

GuestHouse.title: Guest House - SSSUTMS
GuestHouse.content_html: Furnished VIP suites and guest accommodations for visiting professors, industry experts, examiners, parents, and delegates attending international conferences and university convocations.

MOU.title: MOU & Collaborations - SSSUTMS
MOU.content_html: Strategic Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) signed with leading industries, research institutes, hospitals, and national organizations like NCC for joint training, internships, and research collaborations.

Activity.title: NCC & Campus Activities - SSSUTMS
Activity.content_html: Vibrant extracurricular calendar including National Cadet Corps (NCC) drills, annual training camps, rifle shooting, disaster relief mock drills, and social leadership workshops.

Public_Self_Disclosure.title: Public Self Disclosure - SSSUTMS
Public_Self_Disclosure.content_html: Statutory Public Self-Disclosure of infrastructure, governing bodies, fee structures, faculty lists, accreditations, and regulatory compliance as mandated by UGC and MPPURC.

Central_Facilities.title: Central Facilities - SSSUTMS
Central_Facilities.content_html: Centralized computational clusters, 1 Gbps NKN internet backbone, central workshop, seminar auditoriums, solar power generation plants, and sports complexes for badminton, cricket, and athletics.

Institutional_Development_Plan.title: Institutional Development Plan - SSSUTMS
Institutional_Development_Plan.content_html: Strategic 10-Year Institutional Development Plan aligned with National Education Policy (NEP 2020) for academic transformation, research commercialization, and digital learning.

Annual_Reports.title: Annual Reports - SSSUTMS
Annual_Reports.content_html: Comprehensive Annual Reports chronicling university academic achievements, research patents, placements, convocation addresses, and student milestones.

NSS.title: National Service Scheme (NSS) - SSSUTMS
NSS.content_html: Active National Service Scheme (NSS) cell engaged in community upliftment, blood donation camps, environmental afforestation drives, literacy campaigns, and health awareness in adopted rural villages around Sehore.
